name: mia-evidence-2b
architecture: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (low-rank adapters r=32 on 186 linear layers of the text backbone, merged into the weights)
input: text + overall attitude (积极 / 消极 / 中性, from mia-decider-2b)
output: JSON: up to 5 evidence words copied from the text (contribution, tag out of 28, polarity) and logic (pattern out of 12, negation, pivot)
training_data: 3,800 Chinese short texts labelled by an LLM (200 more held out for dev); not distributed
throughput: about 15 rows/s on RTX 4090, bf16, batch 32, transformers generate
